title: Model loop
description: Who owns the repeated model/tool cycle?

zcode.text: Explicit TypeScript turn state and provider projections.

deepseek.text: The agent loop is itself a replaceable Cordis plugin.

codex.text: Rust Session and TurnContext own the sampling cycle.

ax.text: The hosted command owns its loop; AX reconciles task infrastructure.

title: Tools
description: How does a model action become an operation?

zcode.text: Tool scheduling passes through permission and execution.

deepseek.text: Typed pre/execute/post events wrap a guarded pipeline.

codex.text: Requested calls execute and return results to the next sample.

ax.text: Tools belong to the hosted agent; the runner supervises its process.

zcode.text: Lifecycle hooks and separately trusted workspace hooks.

deepseek.text: Native typed events plus partial Codex/Claude hook bridges.

codex.text: Lifecycle hooks around the core turn and tool behavior.

ax.text: No general hook lifecycle; custom runners expose a different seam.

zcode.text: Runtime and plugin declarations load MCP capabilities.

deepseek.text: MCP is a native capability in the plugin composition.

codex.text: MCP startup is integrated into the turn lifecycle.

ax.text: Schema declarations exist; default workspace setup does not materialize MCP configuration.

zcode.text: Plugin manifests include skills and commands.

deepseek.text: Skill catalogs and per-agent capability composition.

codex.text: Skill loading integrates with turn preparation.

ax.text: Skill schema exists; current setup creates a path without fetching registries.

title: Permissions
description: Who decides whether an action may run?

zcode.text: Modes, rules and hook trust govern host operations.

deepseek.text: Approval and escalation coordinate tool execution.

codex.text: Configured policy and hooks can participate in action decisions.

ax.text: Current v0.3 does not supply the earlier human-approval runtime.

title: Containment
description: What constrains execution after it starts?

zcode.text: Shared host execution does not promise a default OS sandbox.

deepseek.text: Platform sandbox backends; host plugins remain outside that boundary.

codex.text: OS-specific execution sandbox backends; Linux uses explicit filesystem and namespace constraints.

ax.text: Agent Substrate actors, resource declarations, snapshots and gateway egress policy.

zcode.text: SQLite sessions plus data owned by other product surfaces.

deepseek.text: Append-only event log with derived model context.

codex.text: Durable threads and rollout-backed session state.

ax.text: Redis resource/status state and persistent workspace snapshots; no conversation abstraction.

title: Clients
description: Where do people and applications enter?

zcode.text: Desktop, web and terminal clients in one product repository.

deepseek.text: Plugin-composed web, headless, SDK and ACP profiles.

codex.text: TUI, exec, SDK and app-server protocol entrypoints.

ax.text: Operator CLI and gRPC control plane.

zcode.text: A manifest bundles agents, commands, settings, hooks, skills and MCP.

deepseek.text: Nearly every runtime capability can be a native plugin.

codex.text: Instructions, tools and integrations around a central Rust runtime.

ax.text: Task image/command and the custom runner contract.

zcode.text: Local application/server with documented remote workspace options.

deepseek.text: Profile-based local or remote execution; preview maturity.

codex.text: Local agent and protocol services with external model access.

ax.text: Kubernetes, Redis, Agent Substrate and container build/registry infrastructure.
